t: This is Sloane Street, a major street in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. It runs from Knightsbridge down to Sloane Square, crossing Pont Street about halfway along. It takes its name from Sir Hans Sloane, the physician, naturalist and collector whose 71,000 items, left to the nation, became the foundation of the British Museum, the British Library and the Natural History Museum. Several people were born or died along the street, among them the Victoria Cross recipient Sir Charles Craufurd Fraser, and General George Alexander Malcolm, the first Colonial Secretary of Hong Kong.
